Description

Made from gleaming metal and countless complex cogs and gears, this draconic creature has the presence of a dangerous killing machine.

Defense

AC 34, touch 14, flat-footed 28 (+4 dex, +2 dodge, +20 natural, -2 size)

hp 172 [280] (24d10+40)

Fort +8, Ref +14, Will +8

DR 15/adamantine;

Immune Construct traits;

Resist Fire 30, Ice 30, Lightning 30;

SR 27;

Weakness Lightning

Offense

Speed 60 ft., Fly 100 ft. (average), Swim 60 ft.

Melee Bite +32 (4d6+12), 2 Claws +32 (2d8+12), Tail Slap +27 (2d6+6), 2 Wings +27 (2d6+6)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.

Special Attacks Adamantine Weapons, Breath Weapon (100-ft.-line, 14d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 22 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Self-Destruction

Statistics

Str 34, Dex 19, Con -, Int -, Wis 11, Cha 1

Base Atk +24; CMB +38; CMD 54 (58 vs trip)

Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

Skills Fly +8, Perception +8, Swim +20; Racial Modifiers +8 Fly, +8 Perception

SQ Difficult to create, Efficient winding, Swift reactions

ffd20-bestiary-builder.sourceText: Breath Weapon (100-ft.-line, 14d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 22 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

description.value: The teeth and claws of a clockwork dragon are made of adamantine and have the qualities of a weapon made from that material.
Built for long and dangerous missions, a clockwork dragon can function for 3 days per HD each time it is wound up.

effect: Built for long and dangerous missions, a clockwork dragon can function for 3 days per HD each time it is wound up. Fully wound: 72 days.

description.value: When a clockwork dragon's hit points are reduced to 10% of its total (20 in the case of most clockwork dragon) or less but are still above 0, the creature self-destructs on its next turn, bursting into an explosion of metal scraps and steam that deals 10d6 points of slashing damage plus 10d6 points of fire damage to all creatures within a 20-foot-radius burst. A successful DC 22 Reflex save halves the damage. The save is Wisdom-based. Construction The clockwork dragon is a masterpiece of clockwork construction and is exceptionally difficult to create. The creator must begin with crafted clockwork pieces worth 25,000 gp. CL 18th; Price 300,000 gp CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS Feats Craft Construct; Spells animate objects, geas/quest, and ultima; Special creator must be at least CL 18th; Skill(s) Craft (clockwork) DC 30; Cost 162,500 gp
